actor_awards.notes: A reliable character actor often cast as tough cops, detectives, or military officers. He won a Primetime Emmy Award for his role as Captain Queeg in the TV adaptation of 'The Caine Mutiny Court-Martial' (1955), a role he originated on Broadway.

filmography.title: A Tree Grows in Brooklyn
filmography.role_description: A kind-hearted beat cop who looks out for the Nolan family, particularly the mother, Katie.
filmography.plot: A young girl comes of age in a Brooklyn tenement during the early 1900s, dealing with poverty and a beloved but alcoholic father.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Supporting Actor (James Dunn)

filmography.title: Bataan
filmography.role_description: A cynical and tough corporal with a questionable past who fights to the bitter end.
filmography.plot: A small group of American soldiers defend a bridge on the Bataan peninsula against the Japanese army.

filmography.title: The House on 92nd Street
filmography.role_description: The determined FBI inspector leading the investigation into a Nazi spy ring.
filmography.plot: The FBI investigates a ring of Nazi spies in New York City who are trying to steal atomic bomb secrets.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Original Motion Picture Story

filmography.title: Somewhere in the Night
filmography.role_description: A police lieutenant who aids the amnesiac protagonist in uncovering his true identity and a hidden fortune.
filmography.plot: An amnesiac war veteran prowls the Los Angeles underworld in search of his identity and a missing fortune.

filmography.title: Lady in the Lake
filmography.role_description: A corrupt, brutal police lieutenant who antagonizes Philip Marlowe in this first-person noir.
filmography.plot: Private detective Philip Marlowe is hired to find a missing woman, leading to a complex web of murder and deception.

filmography.title: Ice Station Zebra
filmography.role_description: The Admiral who briefs the submarine commander on the perilous mission to the Arctic.
filmography.plot: A nuclear submarine is dispatched to rescue the crew of a drift ice station, but the mission is a cover for a race against the Soviets to retrieve a downed satellite.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Nomination – Best Cinematography, Best Special Visual Effects

filmography.title: Peyton Place
filmography.role_description: The town's respected physician who harbors its secrets and tries to guide its residents.
filmography.plot: The secrets, scandals, and tragedies of a small New England town are exposed.

filmography.title: Earthquake
filmography.role_description: A dedicated doctor who struggles to treat the injured amidst the chaos of the disaster.
filmography.plot: Various Los Angeles residents struggle to survive a catastrophic earthquake that destroys the city.

filmography.title: Hannah and Her Sisters
filmography.role_description: The aging father of the three sisters, who continues to deal with his boozy, flirtatious wife.
filmography.plot: Between two Thanksgivings two years apart, Hannah's husband falls in love with her sister Lee, while her hypochondriac ex-husband rekindles his relationship with her sister Holly.

filmography.title: Airport
filmography.role_description: The U.S. Customs chief at the airport who tries to catch a smuggler during the blizzard.
filmography.plot: A bomber on board an airplane, an airport almost closed by snow, and various personal problems of the people involved.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Supporting Actress (Helen Hayes)

filmography.title: Michael Shayne, Private Detective
filmography.role_description: The fast-talking, rule-bending private eye in the first of a series of films starring Nolan in the role.
filmography.plot: Private detective Michael Shayne is hired by a wealthy man to keep his gambling-addicted daughter out of trouble, leading to murder.

filmography.title: Sleepers West
filmography.role_description: Shayne escorts a surprise witness on a train to San Francisco to testify in a murder trial.
filmography.plot: Detective Michael Shayne protects a key witness on a train journey from Denver to San Francisco, fending off attempts on her life.

filmography.title: Blue, White and Perfect
filmography.role_description: Shayne investigates diamond smugglers operating on a cruise ship bound for Honolulu.
filmography.plot: Private investigator Michael Shayne tries to stop a gang of diamond smugglers operating between Honolulu and the US.

filmography.title: The Man Who Wouldn't Die
filmography.role_description: Shayne poses as a husband to investigate a mystery involving a supposedly dead man who returns.
filmography.plot: Detective Michael Shayne poses as a woman's husband to investigate threats against her and uncovers a murder.

filmography.title: Time to Kill
filmography.role_description: Shayne is hired to find a missing coin and gets involved in a murder and blackmail scheme.
filmography.plot: Detective Michael Shayne is hired by a wealthy woman to recover a rare coin stolen by her son.

filmography.title: Guadalcanal Diary
filmography.role_description: A tough, veteran sergeant leading his men during the harrowing Battle of Guadalcanal.
filmography.plot: A gritty portrayal of the American Marines fighting the Japanese on the island of Guadalcanal during World War II.

filmography.title: Captain Eddie
filmography.role_description: The co-pilot of the plane carrying Eddie Rickenbacker that crashes in the Pacific.
filmography.plot: The biography of Eddie Rickenbacker, the World War I flying ace, focusing on his survival at sea after a plane crash in WWII.

filmography.title: The Street with No Name
filmography.role_description: Nolan reprises his role as the FBI Inspector, this time taking down a ruthless crime syndicate.
filmography.plot: The FBI recruits a young agent to go undercover and infiltrate a dangerous mob run by a psychopathic killer.

filmography.title: The Lemon Drop Kid
filmography.role_description: A mobster who threatens the title character, played by Bob Hope, over a racing debt.
filmography.plot: A con man has to come up with $10,000 for a gangster or he won't make it to Christmas.

filmography.title: Island in the Sky
filmography.role_description: A pilot involved in the massive search and rescue operation for a downed transport plane.
filmography.plot: A transport plane crashes in the uncharted wilds of Northern Canada, and the crew must survive the freezing conditions while waiting for rescue.

filmography.title: Seven Waves Away (Abandon Ship!)
filmography.role_description: An injured officer in an overcrowded lifeboat whose survival is threatened by the harsh decisions of the captain.
filmography.plot: After a luxury liner sinks, the captain of an overcrowded lifeboat must make agonizing decisions about who will live and who will die.

filmography.title: Circus World
filmography.role_description: The loyal right-hand man and ringmaster for John Wayne's circus owner character.
filmography.plot: A circus owner takes his show on a European tour while searching for the mother of his adopted daughter.
filmography.awards: Golden Globe: Win – Best Original Song

filmography.title: Sergeant Ryker
filmography.role_description: The general presiding over the court-martial of a sergeant accused of defecting to the enemy.
filmography.plot: An army sergeant is court-martialed for treason during the Korean War, but claims he was on a secret mission.

filmography.title: The Girl Hunters
filmography.role_description: An FBI agent investigating a murder and an international espionage ring, clashing with Mike Hammer.
filmography.plot: Private eye Mike Hammer, recovering from a drinking binge, is drawn back into action to find his missing secretary and uncover a spy ring.

filmography.title: Double Indemnity
filmography.role_description: The sharp-minded claims investigator suspicious of a colleague's involvement in a murder. (TV Movie remake)
filmography.plot: An insurance salesman is drawn into a murderous scheme by a seductive housewife who wants her husband dead for the insurance money.
